builder.notPublic: Left out of the public link
builder.noMoreQuestions: Every property is already a question.
builder.empty: This form has no questions yet.
builder.defaultsDescription: Properties the form doesn't ask for can still be filled in on every row it adds, like Status set to New.
builder.noMoreDefaults: No other properties can be filled in.

fill.viewOnly: You can view this form, but only people who can edit this database can submit it.
fill.archived: This database is in the trash, so the form can't be submitted.
fill.noQuestions: This form has no questions yet.

share.internalDescription: People who can edit this database can fill in the form here.
share.publicDescription: Anyone with the link can submit answers. They don't see the database or its rows.
share.confirmDisable: Turn off the public link? It stops working, and turning it on again creates a new link.
share.anonymousDescription: No account needed, and nobody is recorded as the creator. When off, people sign in first and their rows show who sent them.
share.hiddenQuestions: {count, plural, one {# question asks for people or linked rows and is left out of the public link.} other {# questions ask for people or linked rows and are left out of the public link.}}
share.needsFullAccess: Only people with full access to this database can create a public link.
share.notAllowed: This workspace lets only owners publish to the web. Ask an owner to create the link.
share.stale: This link takes no answers: whoever opened it can no longer add rows to this database. Open it again to take answers on your behalf.

errors.tooLong: This answer is too long (at most {max} characters).
errors.closed: This form no longer takes answers.
errors.signInRequired: Sign in to fill in this form.
errors.rateLimited: Too many answers were sent from here. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.tooFast: That was quick! Wait a moment, then submit again.
errors.expired: This form has been open for too long. Reload the page and try again.
errors.notAllowed: This workspace lets only owners publish to the web.
errors.inTrash: This database is in the trash.
errors.notAForm: This view is not a form.

public.signInBody: This form records who sends each answer, so you need to sign in first.
public.signedInAs: Answering as {name}. Your name is saved with your answer.
public.notFoundBody: This link is invalid, or the form no longer takes answers.
